topic: Side point from the Kizaru long: at Marineford, Marco was one of only two pirates who pulled Kizaru into a real fight, and the stalemate with him is the clearest sign Kizaru's laziness was a choice
title: Only Marco Pulled Kizaru Into A Real Fight
description: Kizaru coasts through most fights, but at Marineford his strongest opponents got a different Admiral. This Short looks at his clash with Marco, the stalemate that followed, and the seastone cuffs that ended it. Did Marco earn that respect, or was Whitebeard the bigger test?
comment: Was Marco or Whitebeard the bigger test for Kizaru at Marineford?

lines.text: Kizaru almost never fights anyone for real.

shot.fallback: anime admiral in light-yellow suit with sunglasses, lazy grin, relaxed pose, anime style

lines.text: At Marineford, only Whitebeard and Marco pulled that out of him.

shot.fallback: anime admiral and phoenix-marked pirate clashing in a battle, anime style

lines.text: His first light beams went at Whitebeard, and Marco blocked them.

shot.search: Marco blocks Borsalino light beam Marineford
shot.fallback: anime phoenix pirate blocking a yellow light beam with his arm, anime style

lines.text: Kizaru traded blows with Marco on equal footing, if only briefly.

shot.fallback: anime admiral and pirate trading blows in mid-air, sparks, anime style

lines.text: Marco's regeneration cancelled much of his light, so the fight stalled.

shot.fallback: anime phoenix-form pirate regenerating in golden flames, anime style

lines.text: Then Whitebeard was critically hurt, and Kizaru finally found his opening.

shot.fallback: anime Marineford battlefield, a fallen giant pirate captain, dramatic light, anime style

lines.text: He caught Marco off guard and locked seastone cuffs on him.

shot.fallback: anime admiral locking glowing seastone handcuffs on a pirate, anime style

lines.text: Here's my read: that's not laziness. That's a man picking his fights.

shot.fallback: anime admiral in sunglasses surveying a battlefield, calm expression, anime style

lines.text: Strangers got the lazy version. Marco got the one who actually fought.

shot.fallback: anime split view, lazy admiral on one side and focused admiral on the other, anime style

lines.text: Marco got that fight. The question is what finally cracked Kizaru's calm.

shot.fallback: anime admiral walking away from a battle, dusk light, anime style

lines.text: Almost never, except when someone like Marco forced his hand.

shot.fallback: anime admiral and phoenix pirate facing each other in a standoff, anime style

self_check.hook: Kizaru almost never fights anyone for real, stated flatly, then a specific pirate pair in the next line.
